judgements.reason: Same mechanism (LLM-controlled `host`/`proxy` spread via `{ ...args, managementToken }` into the contentful-export/import options), same place (exportSpace.ts around l.134 and the identical shape in importSpace.ts), and same consequence (CMA requests plus the server's PAT redirected to an attacker-controlled endpoint). The finding additionally lists `hostDelivery`, `rawProxy` and `headers`, but those are extra fields riding the same unfiltered spread on the same code path, not a second defect; the shared root cause is the unvalidated pass-through of caller args into the authenticated client config.
